The `repel-global` pair expressed one-sidedly: there is no `#Global` tab, and the `secondary` tab carries a `repel primary` row dated at its first shift, so `secondary` reads `primary` and `primary` knows nothing about it. `primary` therefore runs plain round robin alice, bob, carol exactly as a lone rotation would, and is decided first at equal starts because `secondary` depends on it; `secondary` avoids whoever holds `primary` that week and runs one step behind (bob, carol, alice), giving the same ledgers and snapshots as `repel-global`. The relation row stays in place in `secondary`, sorted with the `set` row of its instant, and `expected/status.txt` shows no member twice at the same start.
